question.text: A PMS client is a pension fund with liabilities of Rs. 300 cr due in 25 years. Long-duration bonds that match are scarce in India. The PM can CLOSE the duration gap by using:

answer.text: A combination of available long bonds + IRS receiving fixed

explanation.text: The Logic: Receive-fixed IRS adds synthetic long-duration exposure — bridges the gap when cash bonds aren't available at desired duration. Central strategy for pension liability management. The Trap: Short CP or short G-Secs leave the duration gap wide open — exposing the fund to rate-fall risk.
